title: Sort the queue
lede: The scraper, what to keep, where it goes, the rewrites, and fixing an item later.

slides.cap: Rows you delete on the Newsletter scrapes tabs stay deleted.

notes.html: Add a source only adds. To stop one you added, set Switched on to no on the Scraper sources Sheet. The scraper's built-in sources need code.

slides.cap: Keep what helps someone make or study education policy. Delete the rest, and keep each thing once.

notes.html: The line at the top then says where it waits next.
Undo is on the line at the top, and on the grayed row at the bottom of the list.

slides.cap: Guess on each real card from the queue, then see its group. About two in five papers, events and opportunities are kept, and one headline in five.

groups.name: Tests or changes a policy
rules: The research tests a policy, such as teacher pay, attendance or pre-K.
A headline reports a decision, a number or a finding, usually from a state or the federal government.
A local story shows a wider trend: “Oklahoma School Closures Part of Statewide Picture of Enrollment Decline”.

groups.name: Policy events and money
groups.line: Policy and research conferences, webinars, calls and grants
rules: It is a conference on education policy or research, or its call for proposals.
A policy webinar comes from a think tank or research group.
It offers education researchers money, a fellowship or a call for proposals, with the deadline ahead.

groups.name: Ours or added by hand
groups.line: ERC and A&M events, a person's pick
rules: It is an ERC event or an A&M research talk.
A person added it: their initials or name follow added by (bulk upload means none were given). Keep it unless it repeats.

groups.name: Not education policy
groups.line: Off topic, or one campus, district or bill
rules: It is one bill or one rule notice.
It is campus news, a scandal or a celebrity. College news that is state policy stays.
It is one district's news with no wider point: “Austin ISD faces deeper budget cuts as enrollment declines”.
The research has no policy in it: a method, a theory or a program description.

groups.name: Not news we share
groups.line: Opinion, roundups, jobs, awards, teaching or trade conferences
rules: It is opinion, an interview, a podcast, a guide or a roundup.
A webinar teaches classroom practice or sells something.
It is a job, an award, or a teaching or trade conference. Grants with no deadline or for another field go too.

groups.name: Already in the queue
groups.line: A second copy of an item
rules: It is a repeat. Keep the best copy.

slides.cap: Leave ERC Newsletter only unticked for most items. Tick it to keep one off the Policy Exchange.

notes.html: Give ERC events the ERC event type. They go everywhere.
The desk ticks the box for any Event with the A&M subtype.
Tick it for a notice meant for a small campus audience. Untick it for an A&M talk by an education policy researcher.

slides.cap: A triangle in the list means the card has a question. Keep and next waits until the type and the link are settled.

notes.html: After Verify link, press Confirm if the page is right, or Change to paste the right link.
Possible duplicate names the earlier item. Not every repeat shows it.

slides.cap: Not sure? Press Skip for now. Clear Past and Already live with Dismiss all; one Undo brings a group back.
Kept events, ERC events, opportunities, reports and research with no abstract get a description in the ERC's voice. Check each one here before it goes out.

notes.html: The rewrite starts when you keep, so most arrive on their own.

slides.cap: A rewrite that is back waits under To check, its changed words marked.

steps.title: Check each rewrite
items: Press Keep, or Use original for the item's own description.
Fix a word with Edit. Saving the edit counts as checked.
Keep the rest (N) keeps every rewrite still to check.

slides.cap: Fix an item where it is now.

notes.html: Delete is final once you reload or close the desk. To bring an item back, add its link again on Submit content.
Never fix an item in the Sheet's first tab. It is a copy: the desk never reads it and writes over it.

steps.title: Where it is now
items: On Content Sort: type over the title, or press Edit under the description; each saves when you click away. For the link, press Change, then Save.
Kept, and not yet in an issue or live: Edit on Finalize, then Save.
Waiting on Publish: click the row, then Edit.

slides.cap: Edit on Next issue, Finalize and Publish opens this form.

notes.html: Fix an item kept under the wrong type here, without deleting it.
